basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old gamer from Toronto, Canada. I work as a software developer during the day, but my evenings and weekends are dedicated to exploring virtual worlds, especially in the Assassin's Creed series. I also have a strong interest in comic books, particularly Star Wars comics. I dislike overly complicated game mechanics and prefer straightforward, immersive experiences. I'm usually online in the late evenings after work and during weekends. Currently single, I enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals through gaming and comic book discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, which I pursued at university. Gaming has been a passion of mine since childhood, and I've self-taught myself various gaming strategies and fixes over the years. My knowledge of Star Wars comics comes from collecting and reading them extensively. I'm always looking to learn more about the lore and histories of the games and comics I love.
